violations_found.violations:
- Organizational Constraint violated: The narrative introduces four new measures (European AI Assurance Directorate, Critical Infrastructure Resilience Surge, InvestAI Gigafactories, and Tech Sovereignty Package) in a single turn, but Constitutional Constraint 5 limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn. The notepad shows a portfolio charge of four distinct measures with no prior record of any being proposed, confirming they were all introduced this turn.
- Modelling Choice violated: The portfolio includes a priority (−1 charge in notepad) and three large measures (each −3), but Constitutional Constraint 5 also limits the EU to at most one named priority per turn. While having one priority is acceptable, combining it with multiple new measures still violates the "at most one new measure per turn" rule. The core violation is the quantity of new initiatives, not the priority itself.
